name: pokedock-original-v10-mobile
description: Exact restored PokéDock V10 mobile WebView wrapper

scripts.android:add: npm run prepare:web && npx cap add android
scripts.android:open: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.ios:add: npm run prepare:web && npx cap add ios
scripts.ios:open: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
